description: R62 P1-02 / R63 P0-04 / R64 P0-03: Signed migration manifest — trust anchor for migration integrity. The manifest binds release_commit, tree_sha, per-migration sha256, migration order, and tool version. CI signs the canonical manifest with cosign keyless (Sigstore) and verifies the certificate identity/issuer before any deployment or migration execution. The signature is a detached .sig file alongside the manifest; the manifest itself contains the expected verification policy (certificate_identity + certificate_oidc_issuer). A tampered disk file whose sha256 does not match the manifest blocks startup (fail-closed). R63 P0-04: release_commit/tree_sha regenerated from current HEAD; 004 migration enumerated; manifest must equal the on-disk migration set (no missing/extra entries). R64 P0-03: 007_restore_operations_ledger.sql enumerated (restore orchestrator state machine + blue-green switch + rollback targets).

verification.note: R62 P1-02: Detached signature generated by cosign sign-blob --keyless in CI sign-image job. Verification must pin certificate_identity to this repository's release-gates.yml workflow and certificate_oidc_issuer to GitHub Actions OIDC. Tag-based verification is prohibited; only digest/commit-bound verification is accepted.

migrations.r62_p1_03_note: R62 P1-03: GLOB pattern fixed from '[0-9a-f]*' (first-char only) to NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' (full 64-char hex validation). sha256 updated accordingly.

migrations.r62_p1_01_note: R62 P1-01: Rebuild effect_receipts with UNIQUE(action_id, effect_type, target, request_hash) + CHECK (status IN pending/completed/failed/dlq). Quarantine table isolates rows with empty request_hash. Conservation assertion guards against data loss. DDL_VERSION unchanged (table rebuild, no schema version bump).
migrations.r63_p1_03_note: R63 P1-03: Migration rebuilt with duplicates evidence table (effect_receipts_r62_duplicates) for full audit traceability of all original rows; conservation assertion upgraded to strict equality. sha256 reflects current on-disk content (re-computed after R63 P1-03 changes).

migrations.r64_p1_02_note: R64 P1-02: capability nonce ledger 迁移到独立 CRDB security schema (security.restore_capability_nonces). SQLite fallback 表增加 operation_id / status (reserved|consumed|failed) / reserved_at / failed_at / failure_reason 列,支持 reserve→consume|fail 状态机. 旧 consumed 记录回填 status='consumed'. DDL_VERSION unchanged (列扩展,无 schema 版本 bump).

migrations.r64_p0_04_note: R64 P0-04: outbox_events 新增 lease_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0 (fencing token) + dlq_reason/dlq_at 审计列; complete/fail/renew CAS 必须 event_id+owner+lease_version+request_hash 防御 ABA; 新增 outbox_dlq_audit 表支持可审批 replay. DDL_VERSION unchanged (列扩展+新表,无 schema 版本 bump).

migrations.r64_p0_03_note: R64 P0-03: 新增 restore_operations / restore_operation_events / restore_rollback_targets 三表 — 恢复编排状态机持久化 + 蓝绿切换审计事件 + 限时回滚点. 解决 restore 跨数据源混合时间点问题:恢复只写入 staging,验证后版本化切换,失败只销毁 staging 不影响 active. DDL_VERSION unchanged (新表,无 schema 版本 bump).
